data.name: Interzone
data.detailed_description:
EXILE

Branded expendable by your own government, you are sent into the Interzone, a sealed quarantine where survival is not promised, only expected.

THE INTERZONE

A dark, violent top down open world consumed by collapse, contamination, and unknown anomalies.

  • A fractured territory with shifting dangers

  • Systems have failed, nothing is stable

  • The environment is as deadly as any enemy

COMMUNICATION

The outside world cannot reach you normally.

  • Orders arrive through artillery fired capsules

  • Messages are fragmented and unreliable

  • Tools sent to you are temporary and flawed

SURVIVAL

Everything revolves around staying alive.

  • Manage hunger, thirst, and exhaustion

  • Monitor radiation and contamination levels

  • Limited medical supplies and recovery options

SCAVENGING

Search what remains of a broken world.

  • Loot abandoned buildings and ruins

  • Explore military zones and underground areas

  • Find food, water, ammo, and rare components

CRAFTING

Create what you cannot find.

  • Craft weapons, tools, and survival gear

  • Repair and reinforce equipment

COMBAT

Every fight is a risk.

  • Face infected, survivors, and hostile factions

  • Use melee weapons, firearms, and explosives

  • Ammunition is scarce, every shot matters

ANOMALIES

The world itself is unstable.

  • Deadly environmental hazards

  • Distort space, damage, or kill instantly

  • Some generate rare and valuable artifacts or might teleport you to different areas

WEAPONS

Adapt your loadout to survive.

  • Melee weapons and improvised tools

  • Pistols, rifles, and shotguns

  • Military grade equipment and rare finds

WORLD & BIOMES

A hostile and varied landscape.

  • Contaminated urban ruins

  • Radioactive industrial zones

  • Dead forests warped by anomalies

  • Military exclusion areas

  • Underground networks and tunnels

FACTIONS

You are not alone.

  • Rebel scavengers

  • Military remnants

  • Black market traders

  • Desperate survivors

  • Infected swarms

QUESTS & OBJECTIVES

Nothing is clearly given.

  • Orders delivered through shells

  • Tasks discovered through exploration

  • Clear zones, retrieve items, investigate anomalies

  • Your actions shift the balance

MULTIPLAYER

Survive your way.

  • Play solo or with others

  • Trade, cooperate, or betray

  • Trust is never guaranteed

THE RULE

Nothing stays stable.

  • Areas change over time

  • Safe paths disappear

  • Every decision has consequences

FINAL

The past is gone.
The Interzone remains.

data.short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended

content_descriptors.notes: The player uses melee and firearms to eliminate humanoid creatures and other humans. Blood appears on impact and can also be seen on the ground. The environment occasionally includes old corpses resulting from a nuclear explosion.
